body:
Universalizing restricted compensation certificates and locally characterized quantum routing can silently lose the hypotheses that make them valid. This FQ intake preserves the three incoming streams and adds internally derived proofs, conditional task-matching operations, exact counterexamples and coupled physical qualification gates.

- N822: every smooth finite-jet local storage reduces to determinant-affine support; no universal coefficient-linear selector exists even with arbitrary nonlocal profiles. A supplied strict heat certificate yields full strong-critical trace storage for already certified energies; the full cone remains open.
- N823: acquired task-channel geometry permits coarse or continuous-label routing, with adjacent-pair bias at most 2LR/N. Exact jointly independent product outputs require N>=2m, including nonzero heralding. Hidden bath exchange and reference-only contrasts expose stronger acquisition/interpretation limits. The frozen approximate-bound correction is preserved separately.
- N824: optical overlap/static-phase and independent-port/root constraints sharpen retained-polarity proposals. Hot coupling, losses, pathway, retention and cost superiority remain unacquired.

Preserves 40 original files (329875 bytes) and 81 selected authored/provenance artifacts. Adds five typed bridges, four scoped notices, six open gates, an independent checkpoint, an opportunity lead and an append-only physical model version. Nine GPT-6.1 Sol Max research workers plus one integration worker ran; same-team reconstruction is not external certification. Historical novelty and physical capability remain UNKNOWN. No major breakthrough is claimed.

Validation: 12 fresh copy-first scientific checks passed without published-input drift; generated access build/check, new technology records, publisher software fixtures and scoped additive validation passed. The normal publisher and global checkpoint validator still fail on inherited unsupported schemas. Those historical bytes remain unchanged; the new checkpoint was individually validated and exclusively appended under the existing lock. Source trailing whitespace and frozen CSV line endings are retained; authored-scope diff check passed.

Inspected base: 00631610750c708263d5cf6d812ebbb8edc77335. Open #84/#85 remain conflicted; exact pinned merge-tree and duplicate audits are included. FQ avoids #85's reserved FP namespace. Existing research, branch objectives and source statuses are preserved.

Decisive proofs and continuation contracts: updates/FQ/SYNTHESIS.md and updates/FQ/RESEARCH_HANDOFF.md. Scope receipts: updates/FQ/VALIDATION.json and updates/FQ/PUBLICATION_STATUS.json.
